add_vat: A service costs {amount} excluding VAT. VAT is {p} %. What is the price including VAT?
remove_vat: A price of {amount} includes {p} % VAT. What is the price excluding VAT?
discount_chain: A list price of {amount} first gets a {p1} % discount, and then a further {p2} % discount on the reduced price. What is the final price?
convert: Convert {src} {cur} to {local} at an exchange rate of {rate} {local} per 1 {cur}.
convert_then_vat: A supplier invoices {src} {cur} excluding VAT. Convert it to {local} at {rate} {local} per 1 {cur} (round the converted amount to the minor unit), then add {p} % VAT. What is the total in {local}?
split: A bill of {amount} is split between {n} people. Everyone pays the same whole minor-unit amount (rounded down), and the first person also pays whatever is left over so that the shares add up exactly. How much does the first person pay?
interest: A loan of {amount} has simple interest of {r} % per year. How much interest accrues in {months} months (interest = principal × rate × months / 12)?
margin_price: A product costs {cost}. The selling price must give a gross margin of {m} % of the selling price. What is the selling price?
discount_then_vat: A net price of {amount} gets a {d} % discount; round the discounted price to the minor unit, then add {p} % VAT. What is the final price?
rounding: Give the exact amount in the local currency, rounded commercially (half up) to the minor unit.
